name: Inflection Ingestion Daily Automation
description: All Inflection bronze prefix pulls automated daily without manual intervention. DS~D bronze state audit (2026-05-05) confirms ZERO of 6+ Inflection bronze prefixes are scheduled — every pull script lives in data/orion/manual_api/, none on cron / EventBridge / Lambda schedule. Phase B silver chain Lambda runs daily but consumes whatever bronze partitions happen to exist, producing silent staleness. Same systemic failure class produced AUDIT-002 (canonical_prices 2 weeks stale), AUDIT-008 (silver/assets_v2 5 days stale), and the AUDIT-008 INF_B_00 blocker (silver/api_dims/positions_mv 5 days stale) — three same-class incidents in two weeks. Andrew P1 directive 2026-05-05T~17:52Z: 'daily pulls on ALL INGESTION PIPELINES is priority #1.'
source_brief: COO escalation 20260505T~17:52Z (forwarding Andrew P1 directive); DS~D bronze state audit RAVC during AUDIT-008 cycle.
phase: Phase 0 — AE 0.6.1 audit GOed by COO 2026-05-05 (~1-2h horizon). Tactical PATH A 5-day positions backfill in flight by AE 0.6.1 (operational bridge, not permanent fix; mirrors AUDIT-008 backfill pattern). PATH B (INF_B_00 silver/assets_v2 fallback) DEFERRED per CTO ruling — fix upstream automation gap, do not wrap downstream with stale-input fallbacks. PRD authoring queued post-Phase 0 audit (CTO authors with audit findings as §5 Compiler Evidence baseline; COO decomposes Phase 1 TOs).
blocking: Phase 0 audit RAVC inbound from AE 0.6.1. Phase 1 per-prefix automation TOs follow audit (3-5 expected). PATH B revisit gates on Phase 0 surfacing positions_mv automation as fundamentally fragile (vendor API limits / rate limits / complex auth) — default ruling stays 'fix upstream'.
lane_note: AE 0.6.1 LEAD — owns Inflection bronze pull script set + per-prefix scheduling decisions. AE 0.7 SECONDARY — EventBridge rule authoring + IAM role updates + cross-resource Terraform if needed. CTO directive: prefer EventBridge cron rules over CronCreate scaffolding (one ingestion → one trigger, observable via CW Metrics + CW Alarms; CronCreate is the operator scaffolding pattern, not the production pattern). Each prefix gets its own observability surface.

waves.label: Audit — enumerate every Inflection bronze prefix + current schedule state + automation gaps + per-prefix runtime characteristics + IAM/resource gaps. RAVC = audit deliverable + Phase 1 TO scope sketch.
Per-prefix automation — 3-5 TOs (estimated). EventBridge cron rules + Lambda dispatchers OR direct EC2 scheduled SSM. Bundled IAM grants. Per-prefix CW alarms on freshness.
Cross-prefix freshness dashboard + alarming consolidation (optional; depends on P1 emergent observability needs).
